packageRules.description: Cargo + GitHub Actions: auto-merge minor/patch/digest; majors are left for human review.

The shared reusable workflow from danielcopper/.github is pinned to a commit of its main branch (`# main`). Renovate proposes the new commit, but every bump gets human review: the shared check can block every pull request here. Overrides the digest auto-merge in the rule above.
The Rust toolchain in rust-toolchain.toml: every bump gets human review, since a new compiler can bring new lints and clippy denies every warning.

Never auto-merge a major update, in any ecosystem. Overrides the manager auto-merge rules above for major updates; minor/patch/digest (except the shared reusable workflow from danielcopper/.github) and lock-file maintenance still auto-merge.
